entities.summary: Vassilis Spanoulis, also commonly known as Bill Spanoulis, or Kill Bill is a Greek former professional basketball player who is currently the head coach of the senior men's Greek national team. He was the head coach of AS Monaco from 2024 until March 2026, when the club and Spanoulis mutually agreed to part ways.
